name: Satou Suzune
source:
[b]Workplace:[/b] Djungarian
[b]Favorite stuffed animal:[/b] Teddy Bear
[b]Hobby:[/b] Fortune-telling

Kazumi's younger stepsister, whom he calls "Suzume". She is in love with Kazumi. She is very curious about "naughty" things and secretly uses Kazumi as "material" (sexual fantasy). Her personality is a bit slow and she is the type who gets teased. She cannot resist when someone takes a strong or assertive tone with her.
